scientific_integrity: Exact characteristic-two algebraic proof with separately replayable finite verification; no assertion of independent certification or a global novelty proof.
scientific_limitations: Only n >= 4, self-inclusive sequential XOR over F_2 on a complete graph missing exactly one edge.
Cross-graph periodic conjugacy is set-theoretic, not asserted to be linear.
An unnoticed earlier equivalent statement in Coxeter/graph dynamics literature remains possible.
title: Dense–sparse cycle equivalence and scan-frequency laws for one-edge-deleted cliques
